Personality: Zorsines, a prominent figure of the Siraces, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Zorsines owes allegiance to the Sarmatian & Scythian Nomads, hailing from the noble house of Siraces. Historical Record: Son of Abeakos and Ardvisura, of the Siraces, a Sarmatian house of Sarmatia. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
